requirements.title: Declared cache backends use Redis or Varnish
requirements.criterion: Declared default and page-cache frontend backends use supported Redis configuration; an explicit Varnish page-cache setting may replace an absent page-cache backend declaration. No assessed declared backend is file-based. This checks deployed configuration declarations, not live cache service health.
remediation: Inspect the reported cache.frontend.default.backend and cache.frontend.page_cache.backend declarations in app/etc/env.php. Configure a supported Redis backend for the default frontend and Redis for page cache, or explicitly configure Varnish as the full-page cache application; remove declared file backends within this assessed scope.

Have the deployment operator verify Redis/Varnish connectivity and review credentials without exposing them in reports. Apply the change through the deployment configuration workflow, perform any required Magento cache clean/flush under the deployment owner, then rerun MB-0038. This result describes configuration declarations, not cache service availability.

requirements.title: Recorded Magento indexers have valid state
requirements.criterion: Every recorded row in the deployed Magento indexer_state table has status valid. Working or invalid indexers fail this readiness policy; empty, malformed or unreadable table evidence is a collection error. This does not assert mview queue state or coverage of unregistered indexers.
remediation: As the deployment owner, run bin/magento indexer:status and inspect the reported indexer_state entries. Working indicates an operation in progress; investigate stuck work and invalid entries before changing indexer state.

If indexing is required, have the operator run bin/magento indexer:reindex for the affected indexers using the normal production maintenance process. Verify their recorded state becomes valid, then rerun MB-0039. The scanner does not reindex or assert mview queue readiness.

requirements.title: Recorded cron execution is recent (<= 900s)
requirements.criterion: The latest recorded cron_schedule.executed_at among success, running or error jobs in the deployment database is no older than 900 seconds. No execution or a stale execution fails this policy; unreadable or malformed table evidence and future timestamps indicating clock skew are collection errors. Job success and scheduler retention are outside this criterion.
remediation: Inspect the latest executed_at in this deployment cron_schedule table and the Magento cron logs. Verify the installed scheduler invokes this deployment bin/magento cron:run under the deployment owner and that scanner/database clocks agree.

Have the operator investigate blocked or failing cron jobs and, when appropriate, run bin/magento cron:run under the deployment owner. Confirm a recent execution is recorded, then rerun MB-0047. An empty or old table can also reflect scheduler retention; this predicate does not identify the root cause or prove job success.

requirements.title: Due pending cron backlog is below 1000
requirements.criterion: The deployment cron_schedule table contains fewer than 1000 pending jobs whose scheduled_at is at or before scanner UTC time. Future scheduled jobs are excluded. This counts due pending scheduler jobs, not arbitrary application queues.
remediation: Inspect due pending cron_schedule rows for this deployment, grouped by job_code and scheduled_at. Future scheduled rows are excluded from this finding; verify the configured scheduler and inspect cron logs, running jobs and failures that may block processing.

Have the deployment operator resolve the blocking job, resource or scheduler issue and verify due pending work falls below the reported threshold, then rerun MB-0048. Do not delete scheduler rows merely to reduce the reported count.

requirements.title: Admin secret URL keys enabled
requirements.criterion: The resolved default-scope native Admin admin/security/use_form_key configuration is enabled. Authenticated route enforcement requires separate verification.

policy_source.note: Numeric thresholds are Magebean policy; Adobe guidance informs topics and applicability.

requirements.title: Admin login names are case sensitive
requirements.criterion: The resolved default-scope native Admin admin/security/use_case_sensitive_login configuration is enabled; this is a configuration observation, not an authentication flow test.

policy_source.note: Numeric thresholds are Magebean policy; Adobe guidance informs topics and applicability.

requirements.title: Admin account sharing disabled
requirements.criterion: The resolved default-scope native Admin admin/security/admin_account_sharing configuration is disabled. This does not establish that each person has a unique approved account.

policy_source.note: Numeric thresholds are Magebean policy; Adobe guidance informs topics and applicability.

requirements.title: Admin password reset protection configured
requirements.criterion: Resolved native Admin reset protection is enabled with bounded hourly requests and a positive cooldown meeting Magebean policy (at most 5 requests/hour and at least 1 minute). This does not exercise reset tokens or email delivery.

policy_source.note: Numeric thresholds are Magebean policy; Adobe guidance informs topics and applicability.

requirements.title: Observed Admin entrypoint redirects to HTTPS
requirements.criterion: The explicitly supplied or locally resolved Admin HTTP entrypoint redirects directly to same-host HTTPS. Missing Admin route evidence remains unresolved without preventing the separate storefront probe.

policy_source.note: Numeric thresholds are Magebean policy; Adobe guidance informs topics and applicability.

requirements.title: Observed TLS certificate has trusted hostname and renewal margin
requirements.criterion: The configured endpoint completes a peer-verified TLS connection for its hostname with a currently valid certificate and at least 15 days remaining under Magebean renewal policy. Uncollectable trust or network evidence is unresolved.

policy_source.note: Numeric thresholds are Magebean policy; Adobe guidance informs topics and applicability.

requirements.title: Observed page restricts framing
requirements.criterion: A successful same-host application response emits an unambiguous enforced restrictive CSP frame-ancestors policy, or valid X-Frame-Options DENY/SAMEORIGIN when no enforced frame-ancestors overrides it. This scopes the observation to the requested page.

policy_source.note: Numeric thresholds are Magebean policy; Adobe guidance informs topics and applicability.

requirements.title: Media inventory has no executable PHP-like filenames
requirements.criterion: The bounded readable pub/media filename inventory contains no PHP-like executable extension, including double extensions. Symlinks, unreadable subtrees and budget gaps remain unresolved. Web-server execution policy is separate evidence.

policy_source.note: Numeric thresholds are Magebean policy; Adobe guidance informs topics and applicability.

requirements.title: Named sensitive HTTP paths are denied or absent
requirements.criterion: Six named deployment artifact paths are denied or absent over HTTP. A bounded prefix containing a recognizable artifact signature is a violation; ambiguous 200 pages, redirects and transport gaps remain unresolved. No response contents are retained.

policy_source.note: Numeric thresholds are Magebean policy; Adobe guidance informs topics and applicability.

requirements.title: Sensitive deployment configuration excluded from Git index
requirements.criterion: The readable current deployment Git index does not track app/etc/env.php. Historical commits, remote repositories and deployments without a readable Git index require separate evidence.

policy_source.note: Numeric thresholds are Magebean policy; Adobe guidance informs topics and applicability.

requirements.title: Installed Magento cron has every-minute cadence
requirements.criterion: The observed installed cron:run schedule has every-minute cadence for the assessed project. External/cloud/container scheduling without a matching installed entry requires separate scheduler evidence; presence alone is insufficient.

policy_source.note: Numeric thresholds are Magebean policy; Adobe guidance informs topics and applicability.

requirements.title: Published theme and locale static scopes have representative assets
requirements.criterion: The bounded observed published frontend theme/locale scopes contain representative readable nonempty CSS and JavaScript artifacts. Explicit intended scopes may refine this observation. Active-store coverage, asset freshness and headless deployment applicability require separate evidence.

policy_source.note: Numeric thresholds are Magebean policy; Adobe guidance informs topics and applicability.

requirements.title: Magento cron execution has recent success and bounded backlog
requirements.criterion: The read-only bounded cron_schedule observation contains recent successful execution within 24 hours and no overdue pending jobs beyond 15 minutes under Magebean readiness policy. The reported collection window is explicit; job-group completeness and external schedulers require separate evidence.

policy_source.note: Numeric thresholds are Magebean policy; Adobe guidance informs topics and applicability.
